The '''9K-4 Defense Field Generator''' was a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] system produced by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]]. It was commonly installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as the [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Station]].<ref name="HS" />
